name: flow-telegram-ask-connected
label: Press Start in Telegram
description: Your Telegram account sends its code; the hub validates it. The step finishes by itself once the account is connected.

exe_data.detail:
**1. Open Telegram** — [tap here]({{connect.link}}) on this computer or your phone, or scan:

![Scan with your phone]({{connect.qr}})

**2. Press Start** — the code `{{connect.code}}` is sent with it. (Or send `link {{connect.code}}` to {{connect.number}}.)

**3. Status:** waiting for your message…
